sources.title: [2406.17557] The FineWeb Datasets: Decanting the Web for the Finest ...
sources.snippet: The performance of a large language model (LLM) depends heavily on the quality and size of its pretraining dataset. However, the pretraining datasets for state-of-the-art open LLMs like Llama 3 and Mixtral are not publicly available and very little is known about how they were created.
